## Kill Chain

| Phase | Observed adversary action | ATT&CK | Telemetry | Control status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reconnaissance | _not observed_ | — | — | _not recorded_ |
| Weaponization | _not observed_ | — | — | _not recorded_ |
| Delivery | Phishing link to the login URL. | T1071.001 | Proxy | **detected** |
| Exploitation | _not observed_ | — | — | _not recorded_ |
| Installation | _not observed_ | — | — | _not recorded_ |
| Command and Control | C2 domain. | — | Proxy blocked the second beacon | **blocked** |
| Actions on Objectives | _not observed_ | — | — | _not recorded_ |

**Control status terms:** *not observed*: No telemetry shows whether the activity occurred or whether a control saw it.; *logged*: The activity was recorded in logs, but nothing alerted on it.; *detected*: A control raised an alert, but the activity still ran.; *blocked*: A control stopped this instance after it started (for example a killed process or dropped connection).; *prevented*: A control stopped the activity before it could run (for example application control or a patched flaw).; *missed*: The activity occurred and the control that should have seen it did not.; *not applicable*: The step does not apply to this environment.
